title: Hold a licence to carry passengers or cargo between Australian ports
what: Using a vessel to engage in coastal trading needs a licence (unless an exemption applies).

sources.title: Coastal Trading (Revitalising Australian Shipping) Act 2012
sources.quote: Using a vessel to engage in coastal trading without a licence may lead to a pecuniary penalty being imposed for the contravention of a civil penalty provision.
